# Module M-05: Check product codes stay in the LC-nnnn form

## Lesson

You do this once a week, now that the Monday clean-up has ended. When it works, every code you check is in the LC-nnnn form. [SC-05]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the order sheet and the item list in QuickBooks Online. [SC-05 step 1]
2. Check each product code's form. [SC-05 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

A code in another form goes to the operations manager before anything is changed. [map/future.md item 5]
